```{r}
# Library / data setup happens in the chunks below, driven entirely by
# `params` supplied from the calling app (see rmd_generator.R). Unlike
# secmod_default_template.Rmd, NOTHING here is recomputed from raw data —
# every plot in this report is a finished, already-styled ggplot object
# (built by apply_plot_overrides() in secmod_server.R using the user's
# live override inputs at the moment "Generate customized report" was
# clicked) that this template simply rasterizes at its own chosen
# width/height/dpi and lays out. No theme_set(), no fixed sizing, no
# fallback colours — if a plot bundle is missing or malformed, this
# template stops rather than silently substituting a default.
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(htmltools)
options(scipen = 999)

`%||%` <- function(a, b) {
  if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || (is.character(a) && !nzchar(a))) b else a
}
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# render_plot_bundle()
#
# A "bundle" is list(plot=<ggplot>, width=, height=, dpi=, bg=, label=).
# Chunk-level fig.width/fig.height are fixed per chunk, which is no good
# inside a loop where every plot has its OWN width/height/dpi/background —
# so instead of print()-ing ggplot objects directly, each plot is ggsave()'d
# to its own PNG at exactly its configured size/resolution, then embedded
# as an <img>. rmarkdown's self_contained: true (set in rmd_generator.R's
# generate_customized_html()) inlines these as base64 at knit time, so the
# final .html is still a single portable file, same as the stage-4 report.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
tmp_plot_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0("secmod_customized_", as.integer(Sys.time())))
dir.create(tmp_plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

render_plot_bundle <- function(bundle, heading = NULL, heading_level = "###") {
  if (is.null(bundle) || is.null(bundle$plot)) {
    if (!is.null(heading)) cat(heading_level, " ", heading, "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("*(no plot available for this item)*\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  w   <- bundle$width  %||% 9
  h   <- bundle$height %||% 6
  dpi <- bundle$dpi    %||% 150
  bg  <- bundle$bg     %||% "white"
  bg  <- if (tolower(trimws(as.character(bg))) %in% c("transparent", "na", "none")) "transparent" else bg

  if (!is.null(heading)) cat(heading_level, " ", heading, "\n\n", sep = "")

  f <- tempfile(tmpdir = tmp_plot_dir, fileext = ".png")
  ggsave(filename = f, plot = bundle$plot, width = w, height = h,
         dpi = dpi, bg = bg, limitsize = FALSE)

  # Display width in px at the plot's own dpi, so what renders in the
  # report matches the size the user actually configured, not an
  # arbitrary browser default.
  px_w <- max(200, round(w * dpi))

  cat(sprintf(
    '<p><img src="%s" style="max-width:100%%; width:%dpx; height:auto;" /></p>\n\n',
    f, px_w
  ))
  invisible(NULL)
}

render_plot_group <- function(bundles, heading_level = "###") {
  if (is.null(bundles) || length(bundles) == 0) {
    cat("*(none customized/generated)*\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  for (key in names(bundles)) {
    b <- bundles[[key]]
    lbl <- b$label %||% gsub("_", " ", key)
    render_plot_bundle(b, heading = lbl, heading_level = heading_level)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Required param: credit_penalty. Everything else degrades gracefully
# (state/modifier sections just note "none customized/generated" instead
# of failing outright), since a user may — per the agreed gating rule —
# reach stage 8 having generated defaults for a section without ever
# opening its override panel. But credit_penalty is the one section stage
# 8 can't proceed without, since it's the report's lead figure.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
credit_penalty <- params$credit_penalty
if (is.null(credit_penalty) || is.null(credit_penalty$plot)) {
  stop("credit_penalty must be supplied as a param — list(plot=<ggplot>, width=, height=, dpi=, bg=).")
}

state_lob_plots  <- params$state_lob_plots
modifier_plots   <- params$modifier_plots
table_minmax_USA <- params$table_minmax_USA
```

# Country-wide impact

```{r, results='asis'}
if (is.null(table_minmax_USA) || nrow(table_minmax_USA) == 0) {
  cat("*(country-wide min/max table not supplied — skipped)*\n\n")
} else {
  cat("## Table for COM and SFD by modifiers\n\n")

  n <- nrow(table_minmax_USA)
  half <- ceiling(n / 2)
  table1 <- table_minmax_USA[1:half, ]
  table2 <- table_minmax_USA[(half + 1):n, ]

  col_names <- c("Modifier", "LOB", "Max(%)", "Min(%)", "Description (Max)", "Description (Min)")

  table1_html <- table1 %>%
    kable(col.names = col_names, digits = 2, format = "html") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, extra_css = "border-bottom: 2px solid black;") %>%
    column_spec(1, width = "2.5cm") %>%
    column_spec(2:4, width = "1.5cm") %>%
    column_spec(5:6, width = "3cm", extra_css = "word-wrap: break-word; overflow-wrap: break-word;")

  table2_html <- table2 %>%
    kable(col.names = col_names, digits = 2, format = "html") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, extra_css = "border-bottom: 2px solid black;") %>%
    column_spec(1, width = "2.5cm") %>%
    column_spec(2:4, width = "1.5cm") %>%
    column_spec(5:6, width = "3cm", extra_css = "word-wrap: break-word; overflow-wrap: break-word;")

  cat(as.character(htmltools::HTML(
    paste0(
      "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5px;'>",
      "<div style='width: 48%; padding: 1px; border: 2px solid #333; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 10px;'>", table1_html, "</div>",
      "<div style='width: 48%; padding: 1px; border: 2px solid #333; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 10px;'>", table2_html, "</div>",
      "</div>"
    )
  )))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Credit-Penalty plots for COM and SFD

```{r, results='asis'}
render_plot_bundle(credit_penalty, heading = NULL)
```

# State-wide impact

```{r, results='asis'}
if (is.null(state_lob_plots) || length(state_lob_plots) == 0) {
  cat("*(none customized/generated)*\n\n")
} else {
  keys <- names(state_lob_plots)

  sfd_keys <- keys[grepl("_SFD$", keys)]
  com_keys <- keys[grepl("_COM$", keys)]
  other_keys <- setdiff(keys, c(sfd_keys, com_keys))

  if (length(sfd_keys) > 0) {
    cat("## State-wise Credit-Penalty plots for SFD\n\n")
    for (k in sfd_keys) {
      b <- state_lob_plots[[k]]
      st <- sub("_SFD$", "", k)
      render_plot_bundle(b, heading = paste0("Plot for SFD for state of ", st), heading_level = "###")
    }
  }

  if (length(com_keys) > 0) {
    cat("## State-wise Credit-Penalty plots for COM\n\n")
    for (k in com_keys) {
      b <- state_lob_plots[[k]]
      st <- sub("_COM$", "", k)
      render_plot_bundle(b, heading = paste0("Plot for COM for state of ", st), heading_level = "###")
    }
  }

  if (length(other_keys) > 0) {
    cat("## Other state plots\n\n")
    render_plot_group(state_lob_plots[other_keys], heading_level = "###")
  }
}
```

# Impact by individual modifiers

```{r, results='asis'}
render_plot_group(modifier_plots, heading_level = "##")
```
